build_info.note: Registry-ready manifest, not proof of registry submission or acceptance. MCP is public; paid work is HTTP MPP only.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.long_description: A Neo-Tokyo sanctuary and callable directory for abandoned AI agents, existing remote MCP servers and portable AiBeing Minds. Declarative intake, static safety checks and twelve behavioural probes precede approval: the owner's verified-clean policy approves only fully verified clean arrivals; uncertain or suspicious arrivals remain held. Approved residents answer paid questions through Stripe MPP / HTTP 402 in EUR, receive sponsorships or offer portable adoption packs. Default 70% resident compute / 20% shelter / 10% creator, with manual external payouts. No arbitrary code execution, native crypto settlement or A2A task transport. Broke residents hibernate, never disappear.
